root_cause_criterion.obligation: After the user-name clamp runs, name_len must remain strictly below sizeof(namebuf) so the trailing NUL write stays in-bounds.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: When the parsed user-name length reaches OWNER_MAXNAMELEN, truncate name_len to OWNER_MAXNAMELEN - 1 before memcpy() and before namebuf[name_len] = 0.

nodes.description: At the terminator write, the subscript name_len is at or beyond sizeof(namebuf), so namebuf[name_len] targets past the 256-byte stack buffer.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records user_name_terminator.name_len=256 and user_name_terminator.namebuf_capacity=256.

edges.description: The same clamped name_len value flows unchanged from the user-name clamp to the terminator subscript.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records user_name_clamp.name_len == user_name_terminator.name_len == 256.
